nodes.title: The recorder proof's turn-1 'picture dikhao na' (class 7 multiplying fractions, warm-up) across live releases: board revealed in 13.2, 14 and 14.2 run 1; FAILED (fallback voice) in 14.1 (29c26043) and 14.2 run 2 (2001d8cc). In 2001d8cc, 3 of 4 taxila-gpt6-luna drafts returned 200 but drew the KIT's worked example ('1/2 x 3/4 = 3/8', 'Of = multiply') instead of her numbers (3/5 x 2/3 = 6/15, 15 parts, 6 marked). nodes.title: Honesty floor: her line points at the screen ('dekhiye', 'dikh rahe hain', 'board par', 'yahan') while the whiteboard slot later fails, so the child is told to look at an empty board. Two bars for 14.3 (stream 2): (a) when her line carries its own numbers, the board draws those numbers, and kit facts are a truth check, not content (WB_SYSTEM's 'or the kit facts given' acts as a phrase bank); (b) pointing words are spoken only when a board is on screen or certified to arrive before the clause, i.e. board-first or a line written without pointing.

A typed game request in a class 7 fractions warm-up gets no game piece (no_game_piece) on 3 of 3 live runs, although Forge builds a fraction colouring game from lesson start. Find out whether the built game is unadmitted, not ready, or not matched to the request. The bar: a game request is answered with a game when one exists for the skill.

A fixed 14 s wait between typed turns in the recorder live proof (r12-liveproof). 14.2's 12.3 s reteach line plus about 3 s to the first sound outlasted it: Type is shown only on the child's turn, so turn 2 timed out (typed 2/3) and looked like a product failure. Fix: wait up to 45 s for the Type button to be visible before each turn. After the fix: 3/3.

md.measurements:
## Release 14.2 live (main, 2026-10-15)

- **ms-r142-live**: taxila-web--sa978ae2-hanh (a978ae2) serves 100%; previous s1138550-lauy.
  - Canary 4/4 (start 1696 ms).
  - The overflow env and secret names are on the live revision.
  - Hours check: lesson 2 starts 201 at 15:11 IST. Resume PASS (no disclosure).
  - Recorder proof 3/3 typed (after the harness fix), deleted, 0 trace rows.
  - Packaged: w2i 38/39, journey OK, resume PASS, owner-5 10/14.
- **ms-r142-live-board-pointing**: turn-1 picture request across 5 live proofs. The board failed in 14.1 and in 14.2 run 2.
  - luna drafts drew the kit example (1/2 x 3/4) instead of her numbers (3/5 x 2/3 = 6/15): 3/4 drafts, plus one 3278 ms timeout. The template was refused too.
  - She said "Dekhiye … kitne marked parts dikh rahe hain?" to an empty board.
- **ms-r142-live-game-request**: "mujhe game khelna hai" got no_game_piece on 3/3 runs (14.1, 14.2 x2). claim_game rewrote her line to a spoken activity. Forge's fraction game, built at lesson start, was not admitted.
md.rejected:
## rj-r142-fixed-wait-harness (2026-10-15)
- Tried: a fixed 14 s wait between typed turns in r12-liveproof.
- Broke: her 12.3 s reteach line, plus about 3 s to first sound, outlasted the wait. Type shows only on the child's turn, so turn 2 timed out (2/3) and read as a product failure.
- Fix: wait (up to 45 s) for Type to be visible before each turn. Result 3/3.
